train_cv: three folds withholding train[i::3]; original manifest order
addition_selection: Among additions including single-column variants, lower mean development MAE across seeds wins, breaking ties by column count. For promotion require improvements over base in dev and grouped CV; primary cohort macro improvement >=0.003, no primary cohort harm >0.003, and no aggregate primary 10% hit loss for each seed. Otherwise retain baseline.
pruning_selection: Among reductions within 0.002 of base in both seed-mean CV and dev, choose fewest columns then lower dev MAE. Accept only if MAE harm <=0.003 in every primary cohort and no aggregate primary 10% hit loss for each seed. Otherwise retain baseline. If both gates pass prioritize qualifying addition; do not infer combination.
diagnostics: GP cross-check base, global_shape and development-nominated arms with repository fixed GP; grouped paired bootstrap 2000 by pose or shared 50m XY cell for moving passes; descriptive 95% intervals, no multiplicity adjustment. Window review uses ceil(10% of each nonoverlapping session-specific block of 64), last partial included. Determine normal-score 10th-percentile alarm cutoff on calibration only. Split weather/hour at analysis only.
deployment: Archived replay. Independent transfer and deployability require unused routes. Do not update the default model here.
